data.gender_notes: Nageenah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who brings joy and delight. Derived from the Arabic word 'najana' which means 'to delight' or 'to please'. The name Nageenah carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nageenah usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nageenah, derived from the Arabic language, is a beautiful and evocative name that carries a deep cultural significance. It is a name that signifies joy, pleasure, and delight. In many Islamic and Arabic cultures, names often have significant meanings and symbolize the values, aspirations, and virtues that are held dear in society. The name Nageenah reflects these cultural ideals, as it encourages the bearing and dissemination of joy and happiness, spreading pleasure and delight to those around them. This can be in the form of words, actions, or pure intentions. Moreover, the name Nageenah highlights the importance of bringing happiness and joy to others in the Islamic tradition, emphasizing the communal aspect of living and the shared human experience.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Nageenah carries deeper symbolism and meaning. It is a reminder of the transcendent power of joy and delight, as they are fundamental aspects of both the human and divine experience. The name Nageenah encourages one to seek spiritual joy and delight, not only in the physical world around them but also in the divine worlds that exist beyond. In Islamic spirituality, it is believed that a life spent in pursuit of knowledge, worship, and good deeds ultimately leads to eternal joy and delight in the hereafter. Thus, the name Nageenah serves as a constant reminder and motivation to strive for both inner and outer joy and happiness, in this world and the next. It is a name that carries a deep spiritual significance and serves as a beacon of hope and inspiration for those who bear it, reminding them of the infinite possibilities for joy, happiness, and spiritual growth that await them on their journey towards the divine.
